scope: Derived index of actual native reconciliation rows, combined with the source/assertion review in acceptance-audit.md. This is not a separate test execution or release qualification.

requirements.description: Preserve short calls and earlier API decisions

acceptance.description: Stable lower-priority choice and actual raced victim
Paused consumer/backend does not block publication
Cursor/ticket/counter boundaries and creation timestamp extremes
Backend policy preservation and blocking isolation
Common custom writer registration and ownership
No captured batch versus captured empty
Transitive producer source audit and held-gate probes
Caller cost and bounded atomic work observations
Real native selection and coherent verification gates
Stale consumer index and stable slots
Capture-pass membership and delayed older creation
Stop expiry and safe late cleanup
